# Controls card

<!-- Generated by `node dev/docs.mjs markdown` from docs/catalog.mjs. Do not edit. -->

`custom:more-info-controls-card` renders the row of chips at the bottom of a native more-info, and the command buttons above it. Item `type` is inferred when omitted: `select` for select entities and attributes, `number` for number entities, `toggle` for toggleable entities, `action` otherwise.

## Select chips

Native `ha-control-select-menu` chips calling the same service as the native control.

### select / input_select entity

The state is the selected option.

![select / input_select entity](images/select_entity.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `select.speed`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: select.speed
```

### The dropdown

Options with their icons, current one highlighted.

![The dropdown](images/select_open.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `climate.ecobee`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: preset_mode
```

### Light effect

`attribute: effect` → `light.turn_on`.

![Light effect](images/select_light.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `light.bed_light`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: light.bed_light
    attribute: effect
```

### Fan: preset, direction, oscillation

`preset_mode`, `direction` and `oscillating` (on / off as a select, like more-info).

![Fan: preset, direction, oscillation](images/select_fan.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `fan.living_room_fan`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: fan.living_room_fan
    attribute: preset_mode
  - entity: fan.living_room_fan
    attribute: direction
  - entity: fan.living_room_fan
    attribute: oscillating
```

## Customizing selects

### Filter, order, rename and re-icon

`options` keeps only the listed values in that order; objects rename them and change their icons. `name` and `icon` change the chip.

![Filter, order, rename and re-icon](images/select_options.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
    attribute: fan_speed
    name: Suction
    icon: mdi:weather-windy
    options:
      - value: min
        name: Quiet
        icon: mdi:fan-speed-1
      - value: medium
        name: Normal
        icon: mdi:fan-speed-2
      - value: max
        name: Turbo
        icon: mdi:fan-speed-3
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: hvac_mode
    name: Mode
    options:
      - "off"
      - heat_cool
      - cool
```

### Your own options and action

Any list of options sent to any action: `perform_action` + `data_key` (+ `data`).

![Your own options and action](images/select_custom_action.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `light.bed_light`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - type: select
    entity: light.bed_light
    name: Scene
    icon: mdi:palette
    options:
      - value: orange
        name: Warm
        icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny
      - value: white
        name: White
        icon: mdi:lightbulb
      - value: blue
        name: Blue
        icon: mdi:weather-night
    perform_action: light.turn_on
    data_key: color_name
```

## Visibility

Each item takes `visibility`: the same conditions as a card's Visibility tab (entity state and numeric state, screen, user, time, location, and / or / not, and the other types of your Home Assistant version), edited with the same native editor below each item's form. Home Assistant evaluates them with its own `conditional` card logic, so they update the same way (an entity changes, the screen is resized, the time passes). While the dashboard is edited every item shows, like hidden cards do. A row or the button group left without items is not drawn, nor the card when every item is hidden.

### Items with conditions

The child lock only while the vacuum is docked, and Turbo only on large screens.

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: switch.child_lock
    visibility:
      - condition: state
        entity: vacuum.robot
        state: docked
  - type: button
    entity: vacuum.robot
    name: Turbo
    icon: mdi:fan-speed-3
    perform_action: vacuum.set_fan_speed
    visibility:
      - condition: screen
        media_query: "(min-width: 768px)"
```

## Toggle, number, action and button

### Toggle chips

Name, state and an icon colored when active. Locks lock / unlock, covers and valves toggle. Any item takes `color` (a theme color name or any CSS color) for its icon; on a toggle it is the color while on.

![Toggle chips](images/toggle_chips.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `switch.ac`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: switch.ac
  - entity: switch.decorative_lights
    name: Decoration
  - entity: lock.kitchen_door
  - entity: light.kitchen_lights
    icon: mdi:ceiling-light
```

### Number steppers

`number` / `input_number` entities with their own min, max, step and unit; override them with `min`, `max`, `step`. Changes are debounced.

![Number steppers](images/number_chips.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `number.volume`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: number.volume
    name: Volume
  - entity: number.temperature_setting
    name: Setpoint
  - entity: number.pwm_1
    name: PWM
  - entity: number.large_range
    name: "Big steps"
    step: 50
```

### Action chips

Any `tap_action`. The chevron shows for `navigate` and `more-info` (override with `show_arrow`). Navigate to `#other_popup` to chain popups.

![Action chips](images/action_chips.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - type: action
    name: Cleaning
    value: "By room"
    icon: mdi:texture-box
    tap_action:
      action: navigate
      navigation_path: "#select_entity"
  - type: action
    entity: sensor.outside_temperature
    name: Outside
  - type: action
    name: Locate
    icon: mdi:map-marker
    tap_action:
      action: perform-action
      perform_action: vacuum.locate
      target:
        entity_id: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
```

### Command buttons

`type: button` renders the native square buttons above the chips (like the vacuum more-info). `button`, `scene` and `script` entities work without `perform_action`.

![Command buttons](images/button_row.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - type: button
    entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
    name: Start
    icon: mdi:play
    perform_action: vacuum.start
  - type: button
    entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
    name: Stop
    icon: mdi:stop
    perform_action: vacuum.stop
  - type: button
    entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
    name: Dock
    icon: mdi:home-import-outline
    perform_action: vacuum.return_to_base
  - type: button
    entity: button.push
    name: Push
    icon: mdi:gesture-tap-button
  - entity: vacuum.demo_vacuum_0_ground_floor
    attribute: fan_speed
```

### Missing or unavailable entities

Chips of missing or unavailable entities are disabled instead of breaking the card.

![Missing or unavailable entities](images/unavailable.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `select.speed`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: select.speed
  - entity: input_boolean.does_not_exist
    name: Missing
```

### Many chips

The native container lays out four chips as a 2 × 2 grid and more chips in rows of three; on phones the row scrolls horizontally.

![Many chips](images/many_chips.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `climate.ecobee`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: hvac_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: preset_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: fan_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: swing_mode
  - entity: switch.ac
  - entity: number.temperature_setting
    name: Setpoint
```

### Wrap on phones

By default the chips row scrolls sideways on phones, like Home Assistant (the last chip is cut to hint that it scrolls). `wrap: true` puts the chips in rows instead.

![Wrap on phones](images/wrap_mobile.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `climate.ecobee`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: hvac_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: preset_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: fan_mode
  - entity: climate.ecobee
    attribute: swing_mode
  - entity: switch.ac
wrap: true
```

### Card appearance

`appearance: card` draws a regular card.

![Card appearance](images/controls_card.png)

<sub>Shown inside a popup bound to `fan.living_room_fan`.</sub>

```yaml
type: custom:more-info-controls-card
controls:
  - entity: fan.living_room_fan
    attribute: preset_mode
  - entity: fan.living_room_fan
    attribute: direction
appearance: card
```
